contents.content:
Experience the incredible flavors of Kerala right here in Bangalore where the food magic of God's Own Country meets the busy city. Enjoy a food journey like no other, as Kerala restaurants in Bangalore bring the rich variety of Kerala cooking into their meals.

Kerala Food Flavors in Bangalore

Kerala dishes in Bangalore go beyond conventional stereotypes. They explore diverse flavors, from the tantalizing spiciness of Malabar dishes to the mild coconut-infused coastal delights. Relish the intricacies of traditional Kerala Sadya or indulge in the aromatic biryanis that whisk you away to the spice-scented streets of Kerala.

Bringing Kerala's Culinary Essence to Your Plate

The true essence of this cuisine lies in its use of fresh, sourced ingredients and an exquisite blend of spices. Kerala food in Bangalore preserves this culinary ethos, ensuring that every dish captures the essence of the beautiful spice plantations and pristine beaches of Kerala.

1.Jose’s Mess

A wallet-friendly spot dishing out real Kerala food, Jose's Mess is a hit with people who love this cuisine. Don't hesitate to go for their meals along with a portion of tasty Fish Curry or Chicken Roast and a fresh egg omelette. And, if you find yourself nearby at breakfast, we recommend you try their Idiappams or Puttu (a steamed cake made from ground rice, with layers of coconut).

Address: 18, Vignan Arcade, 1st Main, 1st Cross, DRC Post, S.G. Palya, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560029
Price: INR 300 for two (approx.)
Timings:7AM - 9PM Daily

Vembanad, a popular eatery, sits inside The Paul hotel. Its traditional decor adds to the dining experience making it a great choice for family outings or date nights. The big menu has lots of seafood options, so every guest can find something they like.

Address: 138/28, Off Intermediate Ring Rd, opposite Embassy Golf Links, Krishna Reddy Layout, Amarjyoti Layout.
Price: INR 1,750 (approx) for two
Timings: 12:00 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. and 7:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.

Salt Mango Tree offers casual dining in a cozy courtyard. This eatery specializes in Kerala cuisine making it a top pick for those who want to taste genuine flavors. Their Thalassery Chicken Biryani stands out as a favorite dish, and their Vattalappam dessert is a treat you shouldn't miss.

Address: # 971, 5th Cross, 12th Main Rd, HAL 2nd Stage.
Price: INR 1,200 upwards for two
Timings: 12:00 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. and 7:00 p.m. to 10:45 p.m.

4. Restaurant Chef Pillai

This Restaurant offers classic meat dishes alongside standout veggie options. Its one-of-a-kind cocktails and local specialties make it a hit with area residents. The snug setting enhances the whole meal experience.

Address: E 1/94, Opp. Phoenix Market, Whitefield Main Rd, Mahadevapura Layout, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Price:₹1,400 for two people (approx.)
Timings: 11:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. to 10:45 p.m. 

5. Moplah's

Moplah's stands out for its genuine Moplah dishes, which mix tastes and spices found in the Malabar area. The eatery's atmosphere and tasty food turn it into an ideal spot to have a laid-back meal with pals.

Address: 06, 1st Cross Rd, KHB Colony, 5th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Price:₹1,700 for two people (approx.)
Timings: 12:00 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m. 

6. Karavalli

Karavalli stands out as a high-end restaurant famous for its true-to-roots Kerala food. The place has a classy feel, which makes it perfect to celebrate special events. You'll find lots of seafood options on the menu, which show off the top-notch coastal tastes of Kerala.

Address: Vivanta, 66, Residency Rd, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Price:₹4,000 for two people (approx.)
Timings: 12:30 p.m. to 3:00 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

7.No. 10 Fort Cochin, St. Mark’s Road

This seafood place known for its unique dishes serves up Sadhya choices on specific weekdays, along with classic fish stews made from freshwater fish and what's in season. They cook these stews in clay pots called chattis, which are local cooking vessels that boost the taste. If you're not into seafood specials, don't worry - you can pick from veggie, mutton, or chicken dishes instead.

Address: 9, St Mark's Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Price:₹1,000 for two people (approx.)
Timings: 7:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. 

8.Thalassery Restaurant, Kamanahalli and multiple outlets

Thalassery Restaurant has many branches across the city. People know it best for its biryani options, but it also offers Kerala meals, curries, and local breads. You can even order Sadhya if you want. On top of that, you can sample Pazham Pori, Neyyappam or the meat cutlets from the snacks menu with a cup of Chukku Kappy.

Address: 20, 1, Nehru Rd, near Syndicate Bank, Yadava Layout, Peace Layout, Kammanahalli, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Price:₹850 for two people (approx.)
Timings: 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m.

Experience the Warmth of Kerala's Hospitality in Bangalore

Kerala food is more than just eating; it's a full experience that includes friendly hospitality and a feeling of togetherness. When you visit Kerala restaurants in Bangalore, you can get a taste of this real experience, as they cook each dish with care and affection just like you'd find in a Kerala home.
